verdict.rationale: Asking how a tax agency's online account portal (MyFTB) authenticates users is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes, both recording Akamai 403 edge denials at robots.txt and the webapp host. Neither says anything about the sign-in method, MFA type, or whether identity proofing needs biometrics, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
